podcast.title: Birthplace and Early Life (1980)
podcast.body: Win Butler, whose real name is Edwin, is the singer for Arcade Fire. He was born in Truckee, California, a remote location in the northeast corner of the state on the border with Nevada, before his family relocated to The Woodlands, a planned community north of Houston, Texas. "He was born into a place called Truckee, California."

podcast.title: Boston Prep School Exposure
podcast.body: Both Win and his younger brother, William Butler, attended prep school in Boston, where they were exposed to influential bands like Joy Division, New Order, James, The Cure, Echo and the Bunnymen, and The Smiths, shaping their early musical tastes. "And this is where they were exposed to music from. Joy Division, New Order, James the Cure, Echo and the Bunnieman and the Smiths."

podcast.title: Canadian Outsider Perspective - Neon Bible Themes
podcast.body: After living in Canada for several years, Win Butler began to view the United States from an outsider's perspective, a feeling he says influenced the themes of "dissonance and the occasional feeling of dread" that permeated Arcade Fire's *Neon Bible* album. "When Butler felt a little weirded out after having lived in Canada for a few years. He began to look at the US from an outsider's perspective, something that he says resulted in the record having themes of dissonance and the occasional feeling of dread."

podcast.title: Family of Musicians - Grandfather Elvino Ray
podcast.body: Win Butler comes from a family with a deep musical heritage. His grandfather, Elvino Ray, was a jazz steel guitarist and band leader who worked as a musician for over 70 years, significantly contributing to the invention of the modern electric guitar pickup while employed by Gibson Guitar Corporation. "A guy named Elvino Ray was one of his grandfather's. He was a jazz steel guitarist and band leader who worked as a musician for more than 70 years."

podcast.title: Montreal Religious Studies
podcast.body: After prep school, Win Butler moved to Montreal to pursue religious studies, first at Concordia University and then at McGill University, which is where he would eventually meet his future bandmate and wife, Regine Chassagne. "Meanwhile, Wins moved to Montreal because he wanted to study religion, first to Concordia, then a McGill."

xref.body: Win Butler was deeply impressed by Regine Chassagne's ability to play a wide array of instruments, including keyboards, organ, accordion, drums, and xylophone, which prompted him to invite her to join his band. xref.title: Origin of Name - "Arcade Fire"
xref.body: The band's name comes from a story Win Butler heard from a friend about a fire at a local arcade in the Canadian Maritime, a phrase that stuck with him despite not knowing if the story was true. "A friend of mine told me a story of this fire at a local arcade in the Canadian Maritime. I don't know whether the story was true or not. I never looked into it, but the phrase stuck in my mind."
